digest.component_or_area: Ruff linter configuration and timezone validation
propositions: Ruff ASYNC and DTZ linter checks must be enabled in pyproject.toml after all six current diagnostics (three in src/rebar and three drift-introduced in tests) are resolved to zero.

Timestamp semantics must be explicitly UTC: epoch seconds converted with datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(created, tz=datetime.timezone.utc) and timezone-less persisted strings with datetime.datetime.strptime(...).replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc).
Tests must prove UTC timestamp clustering invariance under at least two distinct TZ environment values on POSIX/macOS platforms using time.tzset(), with platform unavailability causing explicit skip.
Security-pin cadence must remain a host-local calendar-date decision obtained via datetime.now(tz=...).astimezone().date() with DTZ005 compliance.
Production code must use datetime.timezone.utc for all UTC construction and prohibit the literal datetime.UTC token, validated by recursive scan in test_ruff_ratchet.py.
All linting (ruff check --select ASYNC,DTZ, make lint) and test suites (focused, default, integration) must pass after configuration and fixes are applied.
